scene: Inferno XXXIV — Lucifer bound in Cocytus; cross the center of Earth and ascend toward the stars
story: Dante and Virgil enter Judecca, the deepest region of Cocytus, where traitors are wholly enclosed in ice.
Lucifer stands immobilized in the frozen lake, with three faces and six wings. Their beating chills the air and sustains the ice around him.
Within his three mouths Lucifer chews Judas Iscariot, Brutus and Cassius; Dante and Virgil observe their separate identities and punishments.

Virgil tells Dante to hold fast, climbs down Lucifer's shaggy body, and turns when they cross the Earth's center of gravity; Dante is initially bewildered because what was descending now leads upward.
Virgil explains the reversal of their local orientation after passing the center. Lucifer has not turned: the travelers' reference direction changed across the central passage.
They move through the natural passage by a subterranean stream and climb until they emerge under the stars of the other hemisphere.
The Inferno traversal reaches an exit and an observed sky. This seals the second-traversal Stage 041 without altering the separately sealed first journey.
